answer_1.quote: We term this modeling framework NEURAL NORM TRANSFORMER, and find it is able to generate relevant (and potentially novel) rules-of-thumb conditioned on all attribute dimensions.

answer_2.quote: We also provide automatic metrics of the generated outputs. We train attributes classifiers using RoBERTa, and use them to classify the model outputs.
